groups.title: Threat Modeling
groups.question: Explain how you would find the security threats in a system before it is built.

followUps.STRIDE Framework: What do the letters in STRIDE stand for? Give one example threat for any two of them.
followUps.Data Flow Diagrams & Trust Boundaries: What is a trust boundary, and why do most threats show up where data crosses one?

groups.title: Penetration Testing Methodology
groups.question: Explain how a professional penetration test is run, from start to finish.

followUps.Pen Test Phases (Recon, Exploit, Report): Walk through the phases of a pen test. Why is the report as important as the exploits?
followUps.Scope, Rules of Engagement & Legal: Why must a pen test have written scope and permission before it starts?

groups.title: Metasploit & Exploitation Tools
groups.question: Explain how security teams use attack tools to check their own systems.

followUps.Metasploit Framework: What does Metasploit automate, and why does that make patching known bugs urgent?
followUps.OWASP ZAP for Automated Scanning: What kinds of problems can OWASP ZAP find in a running web app?

groups.title: Bug Bounty & Vulnerability Disclosure
groups.question: Explain how outside researchers can report security bugs to a company safely.

followUps.Responsible Disclosure Programs: Why give a vendor time to fix a bug before it is made public?
followUps.Bug Bounty Platforms: What do platforms like HackerOne provide for both companies and researchers?
